customerKyc.title: Buyer KYC
customerKyc.subtitle: Only approved buyers can receive quotations, orders and invoices on credit
customerKyc.notFoundBody: It may have been merged into another customer, or you may not have access to it.
customerKyc.noRight: You can see this customer but not change it. Ask Admin for the sales rights.
customerKyc.linkCompany: Saving links this customer to {{company}} as well.
customerKyc.panFromGstin: Taken from characters 3–12 of the GSTIN.
customerKyc.warnNoGstin: A registered buyer needs its GSTIN before KYC can be verified.
customerKyc.pinHelp: Map pin for route sales and the 150 m check-in (optional).
customerKyc.shipToHelp: Add each delivery site. A site in another state needs that state's GSTIN, and sets IGST on invoices.
customerKyc.consentHint: The customer agreed to get invoices, statements and reminders on this WhatsApp number. Messages go only to verified numbers with consent.
customerKyc.termsNone: No credit terms set up yet
customerKyc.creditLimitLater: The credit limit comes from the credit approval in Phase 6. Orders above it will need Admin release.
customerKyc.nextSubmit: the office checks the GSTIN status, PAN and documents.
customerKyc.nextVerify: someone other than the person who proposed the customer verifies the KYC; credit approval follows in Phase 6.
customerKyc.nextReview: every year, or at once if the GSTIN is cancelled.
customerKyc.cashOnly: Until KYC is complete: cash sales only.
customerKyc.waitingOffice: Waiting for the office to verify.
customerKyc.verifiedOn: KYC verified. Next yearly review due {{due}}.

err.legalName: Enter the legal name as on the GST or PAN certificate.
err.pinBoth: Give both latitude and longitude, or neither.
